payoff.summary: Complete MR-C05-practice, the canonical closing checkpoint, and demonstrate the chapter promise: build short present-tense Marathi sentences with the chapter's first verbs.
payoff.note: The recap says all three sentences about the reader, then shows the single engine underneath them -- an infinitive in -ṇe, a present of stem plus a gendered ending that folds in the "am", the verb last, and "in" on the noun's tail -- and re-banks the roots each verb came from.
